name: Introduction and overview — Type 212 Submarine — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Type 212 Submarine
description: Introduction and overview of the Type 212 Submarine: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The German-Italian Type 212 — ten built — was the first submarine class with hydrogen fuel-cell air-independent propulsion, allowing weeks submerged without snorkeling. At 1,830 tons, the 212A set new standards for conventional-submarine stealth; the larger Type 212CD is on order for Germany and Norway. Baseline facts: German-Italian AIP submarine; 10 built; fuel-cell propulsion; weeks submerged..
how_it_works: Buoyancy supports the hull; propellers driven by diesel, turbine, or nuclear plant provide thrust; rudders and thrusters steer; stability comes from hull form and ballast.
